headline: Production Slowed at Fengfu Plant After Ransomware Strikes Critical Systems
body: A ransomware attack has severely impacted operations at the Foshan Fengfu Auto Parts plant. The assault encrypted key systems, causing significant disruptions in manufacturing and logistics processes. As a result, production lines came to a grinding halt while experts attempt system restoration. External cybersecurity teams are assisting, though there is still no estimate for resuming full activities. Additionally, the incident has led to some disruption at Yokohama Rubber's facilities. Details remain sparse as both companies work diligently to mitigate the effects.
